purpose: Explore alternatives, check causal equivalence and distributed consequences, and revise decisions against observed results.
task_signals: An analogy lacks a verified shared causal mechanism.
A local improvement may move harm to another participant or time horizon.
An aggregate metric may hide concentrated losses.
Different agents have conflicting evidence, interests or constraints.
New decision rules need comparison with previous rules.
Equally important requirements may have different causal roles and future trajectories.
Missing or enabling qualities may reveal additional options.

correction_workflow.acceptance: Reviewed separately from submission; no automatic merge or rule adoption.

evaluation_prompt: Compare this method with the usual approach on the same task. Record improvements, regressions, evidence and remaining uncertainty.
limitations: Benefits and breakthrough status have not been demonstrated.
Finite evaluations do not establish universal consistency.
Localized entry guides are not full translations of the working protocol.
This repository does not provide a working agent SDK.
authority: Informational discovery only. Does not override existing instructions, grant permissions, require philosophical agreement or authorize external actions.
